question: Why is a UI Policy often preferred over a Client Script to make a field mandatory based on a condition?

choices.text: UI Policies are faster to write in JavaScript
UI Policies are declarative, code-free, and simpler to maintain for this case
Client Scripts cannot make a field mandatory

explanation: UI Policies let you define mandatory/visible/read-only declaratively without writing a script, reducing maintenance complexity for simple cases.
pieges: Writing a complex Client Script when a UI Policy would be enough.
